o1.biggest_strength: It perfectly bridges operations and marketing by using the customer personas to shape the out-of-stock strategy, like creating a pro pre-order to stop MUAs from switching brands.
o1.biggest_mistake: Assuming a clearance buyer would pay full unit cost (₹310) for leftover dead stock.

reason: Both are exceptional, mathematically sound plans that nail the core operational brief and constraints.
